- 新增 AI 对话：点仪表盘顶部或阅读页的对话按钮，右侧滑出和仪表盘同样风格的玻璃面板，可以边看笔记边问，自动附带当前打开的笔记。
  New AI chat: the chat button in the top bar or reader opens a glass drawer beside your note, in the dashboard's own style, and can include the note you're reading.
- 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok 和 DeepSeek。前三个调用你电脑上已登录的官方命令行工具，用你自己的账号额度；DeepSeek 填自己的 API Key。仅限电脑版。
  Works with Claude, Codex, Grok and DeepSeek. The first three run the official CLIs you've signed in to on this computer, using your own plan; DeepSeek uses your API key. Desktop only for the CLIs.
- AI 只读你的库，不会修改笔记；每段对话自动保存成「AI 对话」文件夹里的 Markdown 笔记，可以随时翻出来接着聊。
  The AI can read your vault but not change it; every chat is saved as a Markdown note in the `AI 对话` folder and can be picked up later.
- 新增「播客收藏」：粘贴 Apple 播客、小宇宙或 Spotify 链接就能在这里收听并查看 show notes，可以关注节目，有新单集会自动拉取，也能删除单集。
  New podcast links: paste Apple Podcasts, Xiaoyuzhou or Spotify links to listen with show notes, follow shows to pull new episodes automatically, and delete episodes.
- 文章关联音频的播放按钮改成主题色，播放时会有呼吸光圈；宽表格不再盖住右侧的阅读批注。
  The article audio play button now uses the theme colour and pulses while playing; wide tables no longer run under the note panel.

如果 Claude 报 403 Request not allowed，说明它没有走你的 VPN，在插件设置的「代理地址」填上 VPN 的本地代理即可。
If Claude reports 403 Request not allowed, it isn't going through your VPN; set the proxy address in the plugin settings.
